passages.title: Service agreement summary
passages.text:
GREENLINE LANDSCAPING: SERVICE AGREEMENT (SUMMARY)
Client: Harbor View Apartments

Term: 12 months beginning March 1. The agreement renews automatically unless either party gives written notice at least 30 days before the end date.
Services: Weekly lawn mowing, seasonal planting in April and October, and monthly tree trimming.
Fees: $1,400 per month, due on the first of the month. A late charge of 5 percent applies to payments received after the 10th.
Additional work: Services not listed above are billed separately at an hourly rate of $45.
Termination: Either party may end the agreement early with 60 days' written notice and payment of a $500 fee.

passages.title: Contract end date
passages.text:
To: Greenline Landscaping (Attn: Mr. Castillo)
From: Gloria Fenn, Property Manager, Harbor View Apartments
Subject: Contract end date
Date: January 20

Dear Mr. Castillo,

We have been pleased with your team's work this year, and I would like to continue next year. However, our board has asked me to look into lowering the monthly fee. Could we discuss removing the tree trimming in exchange for a reduced rate? I realize I must give notice soon, so I would like to speak with you before the end of this month.

Separately, could your crew replace the plants in our lobby next week? I understand this is outside the agreement, so please send me a quote.

Sincerely,
Gloria Fenn

questions.q: According to the summary, what happens if a payment arrives on the 14th?

why.vi: Trả sau ngày 10 thì bị phạt trễ 5%. Ngày 14 là sau ngày 10.
why.en: Payments received after the 10th carry a 5 percent late charge.

questions.trap: $500 là phí chấm dứt hợp đồng sớm, không liên quan đến thanh toán trễ.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Fenn write that she must give notice soon?
options: The monthly fee is due on the first.
The agreement renews unless notice comes 30 days before it ends.
Tree trimming must be ordered monthly.

why.vi: Hợp đồng bắt đầu 1/3 và kéo dài 12 tháng nên hết cuối tháng 2. Muốn thay đổi thì phải báo trước ít nhất 30 ngày, tức cuối tháng 1.
why.en: The term ends in late February, and automatic renewal can be stopped only with 30 days' notice, so notice is due around the end of January.

questions.trap: 60 ngày là điều kiện khi muốn chấm dứt sớm, bà Fenn chỉ muốn thương lượng lại khi hết hạn.

questions.q: How will Greenline most likely charge for replacing the lobby plants?
options: As part of the monthly fee

why.vi: Bà Fenn tự nhận việc này "outside the agreement". Theo bản tóm tắt, dịch vụ ngoài hợp đồng tính theo giờ.
why.en: Work outside the agreement is billed separately at an hourly rate.

questions.trap: "Seasonal planting" nằm trong hợp đồng nhưng chỉ vào tháng 4 và tháng 10, không gồm trồng cây sảnh.

questions.q: The word "renews" in the summary is closest in meaning to
options: is signed again by the client

why.vi: "Renews automatically" nghĩa là hợp đồng tự động tiếp tục thêm một kỳ nữa nếu không ai báo hủy.
why.en: An agreement that renews continues for another term.

questions.trap: "Ends immediately" nghĩa ngược lại: renew là kéo dài, không phải chấm dứt.
